records.body:
Hi Nora,

records.subject: Welcome aboard, Vantage Partners
records.body:
Hi Nora,

Welcome aboard! Wrenfield is built for teams, so it gets more useful once at least one other person is in it -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Happy to help if you hit a wall.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

decisions.rationale: Account is 6 days old with zero engagement: no first project, no invite, no key milestone, no tickets, and no reply to either outreach email (email:b5ad7a11, email:9de19a3e). draft.subject: A quick hand getting your first Wrenfield project up
draft.body:
Hi Nora,

I wanted to check in now that your Wrenfield workspace has been open a few days. Projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so setting up one real project is usually the quickest way to see whether Wrenfield fits how Vantage Partners works. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time once you're ready.

Would a short call this week help? I'm glad to walk through your first project with you and answer anything that comes up.

Best,
Nadia
